promotional_text: Step into 26 landmarks in 360°, play a narrated tour of any city, and fly through 156 cities and 117 campuses in photoreal 3D. Your iPhone stamps sync too.
whats_new:
New in 2.8
• 360° View: step into 26 landmarks with immersive panoramas, including the Colosseum, Hallgrímskirkja, the Acropolis and the Brandenburg Gate.
• Play Tour: fly from landmark to landmark across a city while each one's story is read aloud.
• Listen: hear any landmark's story from its card on the 3D map.
• Look Around: Apple's street-level imagery on landmark cards, turned to face the building.
• 32 new places since 2.6: 16 cities, including Munich, Hamburg, Glasgow, Bilbao and San Diego, and 16 campuses, including Caltech, Johns Hopkins, NYU and Carnegie Mellon. 156 cities and 117 campuses in all.
• Landmark card buttons fit on one line.
description:
Stamped! for Apple Vision Pro puts the world's great buildings in your room. Fly through 156 cities and 117 university campuses on photoreal 3D maps as big as your wall, and see every landmark you've stamped with the Stamped! iPhone app.

FLY THROUGH REAL CITIES IN 3D
• Photoreal 3D maps with satellite imagery for every city and campus
• A pin for every landmark: tap one and the camera flies straight to it
• Show Apple Maps places nearby: restaurants, cafés and museums

LISTEN, LOOK AROUND, STEP INSIDE
• 360° View: step into 26 landmarks, from the Colosseum to Hallgrímskirkja
• Play Tour: fly from landmark to landmark while each story is read aloud
• Listen to any landmark's story from its card
• Look Around: Apple's street-level imagery on landmark cards

SPIN THE GLOBE
• A 3D globe of every city floats in your room
• Cities you've stamped light up as you collect them
• Drag to spin and tilt, and tap a city to turn it toward you

YOUR PASSPORT, IN SYNC
• Stamps you collect with the Stamped! iPhone app appear here through iCloud
• See how many landmarks you've stamped in each city
• Save landmarks to Want to Visit, shared with your iPhone

DISCOVER THE STORIES
• Architects, build dates, styles and history for more than 2,200 landmarks
• A 10-question architecture quiz for every city and campus
• Search every city and campus by name

Available in 9 languages.

Stamped! is not affiliated with or endorsed by any university. School names and colors are used only to identify them.
